function.name: game_scores_get
function.description: Retrieve scores and rankings based on player’s performance in a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.description: Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

trophy.description: The trophy level for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

Also maybe call with trophy param. But question: "Find out the rewards for playing Fortnite on Playstation platform with different missions and trophies". Likely they want to see rewards for each mission and trophy. So we should call game_rewards_get with mission and trophy. Let's do two calls: one with mission param, one with trophy param. But maybe we need to provide both? The function signature allows optional mission and trophy. If we provide both, it returns rewards for that mission and trophy. So we could call with mission="Battle Royale" and trophy="Gold". But we don't know specific names. Maybe we should ask for list of missions and trophies. But we can just call with default empty to get general info. But the user wants different missions and trophies. So we might call with mission="" and trophy="" to get all.
